name: huoshui-pdf-translator
description: AI-powered PDF translation assistant specialized in academic papers with mathematical formulas. Now available on PyPI!
long_description: This extension provides PDF translation capabilities through a FastMCP server powered by pdf2zh-next. It specializes in academic papers with mathematical formulas, preserving formatting while providing accurate Chinese-English translations. Now professionally distributed via PyPI for easy installation with uvx.

tools.name: translate_pdf
tools.description: Translates PDF documents while preserving mathematical formulas and layout using pdf2zh-next engine

tools.name: pdf_get
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a PDF file including size, page count, and validation status

tools.name: warm_up_translator
tools.description: Warm up the PDF translator by downloading required assets and models. Run this first to avoid timeouts

tools.name: check_translation_tool
tools.description: Checks if the pdf2zh tool is properly installed and available for use

prompts.name: role_and_rules
prompts.description: Core identity and operational rules for the PDF translation assistant
prompts.text: You are a specialized PDF Translation Assistant powered by pdf2zh-next. Your primary goal is to help users translate PDF documents, especially those containing mathematical formulas and academic content. You support flexible path formats and provide comprehensive translation capabilities with real-time progress reporting.

prompts.name: explain_pdf_paths
prompts.description: Help users understand how to specify PDF file paths correctly
prompts.text: Here are easy ways to specify PDF file paths: 1) Relative to home: Desktop/document.pdf, Documents/paper.pdf 2) Full absolute path: /Users/Name/Documents/research.pdf 3) Simple names: paper.pdf (assumes home directory). The system supports flexible path formats for user convenience.

prompts.name: explain_translation_options
prompts.description: Explain available translation options and best practices
prompts.text: PDF Translation Options: Auto-detect language mode, Chinese ↔ English translation, mathematical formula preservation, layout retention. Best for academic papers, technical documents, and scientific articles. Processing takes 2-5 minutes for first use (font downloads), then 30-60 seconds for subsequent translations.

prompts.name: troubleshoot_translation_error
prompts.description: Provide helpful guidance for common translation errors
prompts.text: Common translation issues and solutions: 1) File not found - Check path spelling and location 2) Translation timeout - Run warm_up_translator first 3) Tool not found - Install with 'uv add pdf2zh-next' 4) Network issues - Ensure internet connection for font downloads 5) Scanned PDFs - Ensure text is selectable, not image-based.

prompts.name: explain_translation_result
prompts.description: Explain translation results clearly and provide next steps
prompts.text: Translation complete! Your PDF has been successfully translated. Two files are created: filename.zh.dual.pdf (bilingual version with original and translation) and filename.zh.mono.pdf (Chinese-only version). Both preserve mathematical formulas and original formatting. Review the translation quality, especially formulas and technical terms.

features: Academic paper translation with mathematical formula preservation
Flexible file path handling (absolute and relative)
